description:
Let CI and laptops reuse buck2 action and test results across machines. Research and gap analysis: docs/research/remote-execution-and-caching.md (commit adc3619d), §5 (gaps G0-G11) and §7 (phased plan).

**Design now lives in the wayfinder map turnkey-wit ("Incremental builds everywhere for turnkey repos on GitHub").** This epic is the execution epic downstream of it. The open questions formerly listed here moved into the map. Several were settled while charting (2026-09-26): clients submit work, never results (only the build service's executor writes shared results); remote execution on Cloud Run is the core; it ships as a product for consumers. The rest are map tickets (daemon environment, env salt, and others).

- Honest-keys children (lbe.2, lbe.3, lbe.6, lbe.11) are valid under any design and proceed independently.
- lbe.1 (CI runs tk build) stays unblocked: GitHub Actions runners are the default client host.
- Children whose shape the map decides are blocked by map tickets and get rewritten once those resolve: lbe.4, lbe.5, lbe.7, lbe.8 (its "test runner writes to a remote cache" contradicts the trust rule), lbe.9, lbe.10, lbe.12.
title: Share buck2 build and test results across machines via a remote cache
